channel.title: Nature Materials
channel.description: Nature Materials is a multidisciplinary journal aimed at bringing together cutting-edge research across the entire spectrum of materials science and technology. Nature Materials covers all applied and fundamental aspects of the synthesis/processing, structure/composition, properties and performance of materials. Nature Materials provides a forum for the development of a common identity among materials scientists while encouraging researchers to cross established subdisciplinary lines. To achieve this, Nature Materials takes an interdisciplinary, integrated and balanced approach to all areas of materials research while fostering the exchange of ideas between scientists involved in different communities.

item.title: [6] Excitonic spin torque in a magnetic semiconductor
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Yafei Ren, Youn Jue Bae

Authors: Nicholas J. Brennan, Jiacheng Tang, Jalil Varela-Manjarres, et al.

Score 6/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Relevant study of magnetism and excitons in a 2D antiferromagnetic semiconductor.

Tags: #magnetism #2Dmaterial #semiconductor

Abstract: Nature Materials, Published online: 15 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41563-026-02643-1 Distinct magnon dynamics are observed at high excitation pump power in the two-dimensional antiferromagnetic semiconductor CrSBr, and attributed to an interplay between excitons and magnetization.

item.title: [7] Polar nano-regions enable large spin Hall conductivity in metallic PtCoO2
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Rong Yu, Tianxiang Nan

Authors: Guiping Ji, Yi Zheng, Yuejie Zhang, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Interesting electronic transport and structural study in a metallic delafossite.

Tags: #transport #delafossite #symmetry

Abstract: Nature Materials, Published online: 12 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41563-026-02640-4 A large spin Hall conductivity is reported for the quasi-two-dimensional metallic delafossite PtCoO2 and attributed to polar lattice distortions that break inversion symmetry.
